Rho 0.4.0-dev.41 is an acceptance-only native updater target.

## Acceptance scope

- This public prerelease exists only for a controlled Windows and macOS native
  updater acceptance test from the immutable `dev.40` Draft.
- It is excluded from the normal Update Site and is not a normal product
  release, a `dev.40` publication, or a permanent native updater endpoint.
